sentences.en: Hostilities between Algeria and Morocco have always been kept low.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚和摩洛哥之间的敌意一直保持在较低水平。

sentences.en: Currently in this area there are no active hostilities.
sentences.zh: 目前在这个地区并没有活跃的敌对行为。

sentences.en: Analysts sense a growing hostility between the two countries.
sentences.zh: 分析师感觉到两国之间敌意正在增长。

senses.zh: 敌意，敌对，对抗；抵制，反对，否决；[pl.] 交战，战争

mnemonic: 词根记忆：host（敌人）+ility→敌意，敌对
